material.acceptance_criteria: Each narrowing is checked (try_from with a named bail) or validate.rs refuses the over-long value before encode runs; mapexport on an oversized name exits with a message.
material.description: rust/crates/data/src/format.rs:204 name.len() as u8 in encode_name_list; rust/crates/data/src/encode.rs:19 text.len() as u16 in Strings.intern, :263 route.points.len() as u16. validate.rs bounds some counts (:127,:220,:302) but not name byte length or route points; a 256-byte name or 65536-byte string would wrap and write a corrupt image that reader.rs may still accept. No public references: the OSDT image layout is this repository's own, so no upstream implementation applies. Name-list entries and route points are already refused upstream (validate.rs bounds each name list entry to one byte; the OSDT parser refuses route points past 64), leaving the string table as the last unchecked narrowing.
material.subject: Image encoding narrows name and string lengths with as u8 and as u16 and no check
material.witness: validate.rs now bails when a unit model path exceeds u16::MAX bytes. Live: mapexport over a copy of scenarios/moba whose first unit model is 70000 bytes exits 1 with "unit hero model path is 70000 bytes; the string table stores a string length in two bytes"; the unmodified scenario still writes 939566 bytes.
material.witness_plan: Native: mapexport over a scratch pack with a 300-byte name (out of tree), expect a refusal, not an image.
